sources.title: BMC Amended Standing Order1-09
sources.retrieval: Official indexed full text via web search; no local downloaded bytes claimed.
sources.findings: Consolidated dismissal/nolle records require at least three cases from at least two BMC divisions. Venue follows residence, otherwise most recent record. Participant sends DA copy30days before final hearing unless waived. Court handles public notice and docket/order distribution. A petition form is available; no new form-acquisition hold inferred.

sources.title: Request to seal your criminal record
sources.retrieval: Official indexed text via web search; direct open failed.
sources.findings: CORI and certified dockets are recommended, not mandatory filing attachments. No sealing filing fee. BMC final hearing after prima-facie review; participant notice remains required.
